name: narrated-video-kit
description: Narrated explainer videos built in code with Remotion: one scene per script line, word-timed cues and captions, an optional ElevenLabs voice, a 16:9 cut of every vertical video, SRT export, loudness leveling, thumbnails and review sheets.
author: GoodHandoff (https://goodhandoff.com)

scripts.smoke: remotion still src/index.ts sheet-explainer out/smoke/sheet.png && remotion still src/index.ts sheet-explainer-wide out/smoke/sheet-wide.png && remotion still src/index.ts thumb-explainer-a out/smoke/thumb-a.jpg --image-format=jpeg
scripts.check: npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm run coverage && npm run build && npm run check:licenses
